items.name: Show in Friendslist
items.note: Shows the platform indicators in the friendslist.

items.name: Show in Memberlist
items.note: Shows the platform indicators in the memberlist.

items.name: Show in Chat
items.note: Shows the platform indicators next the username in messages.

items.name: Show in DMs
items.note: Shows the platform indicators in the dm list.

items.name: Show in Favorites
items.note: Shows the platform indicators in favorites.

items.name: Show on Avatars
items.note: Replaces the status dot on avatars with the platform icon.

items.name: Show in Discord Badges
items.note: Shows the platform indicators right next to the discord badges.

items.name: Ignore Bots
items.note: Ignores the status of bots, which is usually web anyway.

items.name: Platform Icons
items.note: Choose which platform indicators are shown next to names and badges, and which ones replace the status dot on avatars.
